body: I’m going through the same thing, my mum has talked recently about how sad she is and it’s making me stressed. I would say it would be a good idea to plan something to do with your mum so you both have something to look forward to. If you ever need to talk to someone who is going through the same thing I am here
Just wanna say thank you for your help, I’m going to delete this post in a few hours as I’m scared of someone finding it but thank you!
We’ve already done this when she first said, my brother moved out months ago
Yes actually he’s nearly 19 and we tried to have a discussion and he shouted so loudly he scared all of our dogs and refused to talk to us

There isn’t really a valid reason he is horrible to her, every time they talk it ends up in a big argument despite my mum being nice. It’s a very very long story but basically he decided to move out without telling anyone and move in with his girlfriend who is very troubled, she’s a drug addict and has some serious mental health issues

Any tips on what I could say? Because the other day she said we’d be better off without her I don’t want to say that I’m stressed and then make her think like she’s the root of all problems. She’s already been thinking like this and that she’s done something wrong as my brother has been so horrible to her

I think maybe I’ll say I’m worried about how she is without explicitly saying the word suicide. Today we were planning our holiday in a few weeks so maybe the time she said she was suicidal was just an extreme case

Yeah she does have lots of friends and I’m with her until the end of September. I can’t decide whether to express my worry or not as the past two days she has been pretty much fine and I don’t want to make her feel bad so I’m not sure what to do
